1. Scope 1.1 This Grievance Redressal Policy(“Grievance Policy”)describesthemechanismbywhich Byte Mart receives, processes, and resolves complaints, grievances, and queries from Users inconnectionwiththe Platform,Products,Orders,deliveries,payments,refunds,andprivacy. 1.2 This Grievance Policyispublishedincompliancewith: (a)Regulation 4 ofthe Consumer Protection(E-Commerce)Rules, 2020(appointmentofgrievanceofficerandgrievancere- dressalmechanism);(b)Regulation 4(2) of the IT (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021 (grievance officer for intermediaries); (c) Section 12 of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023(righttogrievanceredressalby Data Prin- cipal);(d)Section 35 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019(consumerdisputeredressal forums). 1.3 This Grievance Policy forms an integral part of the Byte Mart Terms and Conditions. 2. Grievance Officer 2.1 Byte Marthasappointeda Grievance Officerinaccordancewiththe ITR ules 2021 andthe E-Commerce Rules 2020. The Grievance Officeristhesinglepointofcontactforallconsumer and data-related grievances. 2.2 Grievance Officer Details: Name: [GRIEVANCE OFFICER NAME] Designation: Grievance Officer Entity: Byte Mart [Private Limited / Limited] Registered Office: [ADDRESS], New Delhi, India Email: [grievance@bytemart.in] Phone: [PHONE] Working Hours: [DAYS / TIMINGS, e.g., Monday to Friday, 10:00 to 18:00 IST] 2.3 The Grievance Officer’s name, designation, and contact details are displayed: (a) On the Platform’s home page footer; (b) On the “Contact Us” page; (c) In the Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy; (d) On every Product page; and (e) In every transactional email. 3. Channels for Filing a Grievance 3.1 Users may file a grievance through any of the following channels: (a) Email: [grievance@bytemart.in] (preferred channel — provides written record); (b) Phone: [PHONE] (during working hours); (c) Postal: Grievance Officer, [ADDRESS], New Delhi, India; (d) Portal: “Help & Support” or “My Orders” → “Report an Issue” on the Platform; (e) Chat: [If live chat is available] 3.2 The following information should be provided to enable prompt resolution: (a) Full name and registered email/mobile number; (b) Order number (if applicable); (c) Description of the grievance;(d)Dateandtimeoftheissue(ifknown);(e)Photographicordocumentaryevidence (if applicable); (f) Desired resolution. 4. Acknowledgement & Response Timelines 4.1 Byte Mart shall acknowledge receipt of every grievance within forty-eight (48) hours of receipt, by email or SMS to the contact details provided by the User. 4.2 Byte Mart shall endeavour to resolve every grievance within thirty (30) days of receipt, in accordance with the DPDPA and the E-Commerce Rules, 2020. 4.3 For specific categories of grievances, the following internal timelines shall apply: 37

10.4 Pre-Orders During Sales 10.4.1 Duringapromotionalsale(includingbutnotlimitedtofestivesales,flashsales,anniver- sary sales, and clearance sales), Byte Mart may, at its sole discretion, accept or not accept Pre-Orders for selected Products. 10.4.2 Where Pre-Ordersareacceptedduringasale,the Buyermayplacea Pre-Orderthrough the Platform during the active promotional period. The Pre-Order will be honoured at the promotional price, subject to stock and the terms of the Pre-Order. 10.4.3 Where Pre-Orders are not accepted during a sale, the Platform shall not display any “Pre-Order” or “Notify Me” option for the affected Product(s). The Buyer may purchase the Product only when (and if) it becomes available for regular sale at the regular price. 10.4.4 For the avoidance of doubt, the general rules on offers and promotions in Clause 10 of the Payment and Pricing Policy apply to Pre-Orders placed during a sale. 11. Delivery to Multiple Addresses 11.1 Byte Mart currently supports delivery to a single address per Order. If the Buyer wishes to ship Products to multiple addresses, separate Orders must be placed. 12. Change of Delivery Address 12.1 The Buyer may request a change of delivery address prior to dispatch by contacting [support@bytemart.in]. Byte Mart may, at its sole discretion, accept or reject the request. 12.2 Once an Order has been dispatched from the warehouse, the Buyer cannot re- quest a change of delivery address. The Order shall be delivered to the address on file at the time of dispatch, and any redirection request thereafter shall not be entertained. 12.3 Ifthe Buyerisunavailableatthedispatch-timeaddress,thestandardfailed-deliveryand RTO process under Clauses 7 and 8 shall apply. The Order may be cancelled and refunded in accordancewiththe Cancellation Policy,withthe Fast Deliverychargeand(whereapplicable) the COD Charge not refunded, in accordance with the Payment and Pricing Policy. 13. International Shipping 13.1 Byte Mart currently does not offer international shipping. Products are delivered within the territory of India only. 14. Compliance Disclosures 14.1 In accordance with the E-Commerce Rules, 2020, Byte Mart displays the following information on every Product page and at checkout: (a) Name and principal address of Byte Mart; (b) GSTIN, CIN, and other statutory registration numbers; (c) Country of origin of each Product; (d) Delivery options, charges, and estimated timelines; (e) Grievance Officer contact details. 21
